verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Your grace is enough, more than I need
At Your word I will believe

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
I wait for You, draw near again
Let Your Spirit make me new

verse.name: p1a
verse.lines:
And I will fall at Your feet
I will fall at Your feet

verse.name: p1b
verse.lines: And I will worship You here

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Your presence in me, Jesus light the way
By the power of Your word

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
I am restored, I am redeemed
By Your Spirit I am free

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Freely You gave it all for us
Surrendered Your life upon that cross

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Great is the love poured out for all
This is our God

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
Lifted on high from death to life
Forever our God is glorified

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines:
Servant and King rescued the world
This is our God
